div.ab: Teste Willelmo cancellario et Roberto comite de Mellent et R[odberto] filio Hamonis et R[icardo] de Retuers. Apud Westmonasterium in natale Domini.
Teste Willelmo cancellario et Roberto Comite de Mellent et R[odberto] filio Hamonis et R[icardo] de Retuers. Apud Westmonasterium in natale Domini.
Witnesses: Chancellor William and Earl Robert de Meulan and Robert FitzHamo and Richard de Retuers. At Westminster at Christmas.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 284–285 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text added from Gesetze I p. 523, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)

note.seg: Im Ggs. zu CHn cor Test{c} heisst Giffard hier nicht ‘Erwählter von Winchester’, viell. weil der König ihn zu weihen verboten hatte, wenn Anselm nicht auch die gegen kanonisches Verbot Investierten weihen würde

In contrast to CHn cor Test{c}, Giffard is not called ‘elect of Winchester’ here, perhaps because the king had forbidden his consecration unless Anselm would also consecrate those invested contrary to the canonical prohibition
Meulan, Heinrichs wichtigster Staatsmann, bezeugt auch u. Hn com
Meulan, Henry's most important statesman, also witnesses below Hn com
S. CHn cor Test{m}. Rivers, der Vater des ersten Grafen von Devon (Round Feudal. Engl. 486), steht bei Will. Malmesb. (Reg. V 394) unter Heinrichs Parteigängern gegen Robert v. d. Normandie a. 1100f.
See CHn cor Test{m}. Rivers, the father of the first Earl of Devon (Round Feudal. Engl. 486), appears in Will. Malmesb. (Reg. V 394) among Henry's partisans against Robert of Normandy in 1100f.
